"Very nice location you've set up here, Mr. President."
"Oh this place is not mine. It's Petr's."

entradas.text: He straightened himself.
It was yet another sunny day, and I was facing another important political figure: Heron Garaci.
Lucian had managed to convince him to have a meeting with me just before the Court vote.
The bribe had worked and he agreed to have a meeting with me just before the Court vote.
We scheduled to meet outside of Holsord, in my new vineyard in Erlory, where we could have some privacy.
We scheduled to meet outside of Holsord, in the Gentlemen's Club of Petr in Erlory, where we could have some privacy.
I grabbed a drink and sat down under the shadow of a red oak at the villa's garden overlooking the red grapevines.
I grabbed a drink and sat down on the balcony of the villa overlooking its vast garden.
"Very nice place you've got here, Mr. President."
He had reached out to us and wished for a meeting just ahead of the Court vote.
Heron sat next to me in his beige checked suit and took off his white trilby.
Heron sat next to me in his beige checked suit and took off his white trilby.
"Didn't know you were a winegrower."
"A Gentlemen's Club, huh?"
"We thought this place would be fitting."
entradas.menu: "We thought this place would be fitting."

entradas.text: "I don't set up meetings. My team chose this place."
entradas.menu: "I don't set up meetings. My team chose this place."

entradas.text: "Didn't know the Vice President had such good taste."
"Yes. Fitting."
"Please send my regards to your team then."
"Oh I'm not. I just recently bought this place."
entradas.menu: "Oh I'm not. I just recently bought this place."

entradas.text: "Me neither. It just happened."
entradas.menu: "Me neither. It just happened."

entradas.text: "I like the calmness here. And the sight of the grapevines."
entradas.menu: "I like the calmness here. And the sight of the grapevines."

entradas.text: "Well, I'll be looking forward to have a taste of your wines."
"You're lucky to have such a place to come and relax."
He straightened himself.
"So, Mr. President... I wanted to talk to you for a couple of reasons."
"So, Mr. President..."
"Your gesture of goodwill went a long way. Please do speak of your intentions and how I could I be of assistance to you."
"You went a long way to make this meeting possible. I had to pay you the respect."
"Please do speak of your intentions and how I could I be of assistance to you."
"I want you and your buddies in the Court to pass the changes."
entradas.menu: "I want you and your buddies in the Court to pass the changes."

entradas.text: "You know what I want."
entradas.menu: "You know what I want."

entradas.text: "I'm waiting for your gesture of goodwill now."
entradas.menu: "I'm waiting for your gesture of goodwill now."

entradas.text: "We need your help with the upcoming vote."
entradas.menu: "We need your help with the upcoming vote."

entradas.text: "I believe I have already showed that by coming here. Behind the Chief Justice's back."
"You know I'm taking a risk here."
"I don't like to speculate. I want you to ask it yourself."
"Yes. Not an easy thing to make it happen."
"I'm prepared to do that."
"But I'm prepared to help with that."
"As long as we help each other."
"Don't you dare opposing me after you accepted my money."
entradas.menu: "Don't you dare opposing me after you accepted my money."

entradas.text: "You know I'm taking a much higher risk here, Mr. Garaci."
entradas.menu: "You know I'm taking a much higher risk here, Mr. Garaci."

entradas.text: "Look. I need your help with the upcoming vote."
entradas.menu: "Look. I need your help with the upcoming vote."

entradas.text: "I'm not here to play your games."
entradas.menu: "I'm not here to play your games."

entradas.text: "Drop the act, Mr. Garaci. Let's not waste each other's time."
entradas.menu: "Drop the act, Mr. Garaci. Let's not waste each other's time."

entradas.text: "Fine."
"I have not yet decided what to do."
"Perhaps you are right. You have already taken so much by getting involved in bribery."
"Let's not forget that you gave me evidence that could lead to a trial."
He puffed himself up.
"I can help you beyond this vote."
"Wouldn't you want to have a Chief Justice who'd be sympathetic to your concerns. Doesn't it sound nice?"
"I'm listening."
entradas.menu: "I'm listening."

entradas.text: "I don't think you would be that person."
entradas.menu: "I don't think you would be that person."

entradas.text: "So you want to take Orso's place huh?"
entradas.menu: "So you want to take Orso's place huh?"

entradas.text: He took a sip from his drink.
"I'll be straightforward, Mr. President."
"First of all, I have to say that I'm behind your proposal. It is the position of the majority of the Sollist Justices."
"We didn't want to create unnecessary risks by talking to you directly until now."
"I really did not expect this."
entradas.menu: "I really did not expect this."

entradas.text: "So the Old Guard has actually decided to support me?"
entradas.menu: "So the Old Guard has actually decided to support me?"

entradas.text: "I'll admit, it's a nice surprise to hear this from you."
entradas.menu: "I'll admit, it's a nice surprise to hear this from you."

entradas.text: "Sounds too good to be true. I was told otherwise about your stance."
entradas.menu: "Sounds too good to be true. I was told otherwise about your stance."

entradas.text: "We can't be open about this now, can we?"
"Some of us see no problem with your proposal."
"The problem is the Chief Justice."
"He is fanatically working to undermine you. I'm afraid that it has gone too far. There are plans of..."
He coughed and took a sip from his drink.
"Well... He is organizing the Sollists against you. He has influence over a lot of people as you know, but he's now losing the Supreme Court's support."
"You're right. It does sound rather nice."
entradas.menu: "You're right. It does sound rather nice."

entradas.text: "Is it really that unexpected?"
"I would be. If you allow me."
"Well, I agree."
"I already have a reasonable support behind me. If Orso is dismissed from the Court, I can take his place and keep helping you."
"We must think beyond the vote, Mr. President."
"If you promise me to go ahead with it, I can provide you with some evidence against him. If we pass your proposal, you can use it to impeach him."
"Promise me that you will dismiss him from the Supreme Court. And him only."
"And I will support you not only with the vote but afterwards."
"I thought you were the one who asked for my help, Mr. President."
"I gave you my offer. If you don't like it, there will be no support from my end. Easy as that."
"I already wanted to do that."
entradas.menu: "I already wanted to do that."

entradas.text: "I like the offer. It's a deal."
entradas.menu: "I like the offer. It's a deal."

entradas.text: "Are you positive the evidence can lead to his impeachment?"
entradas.menu: "Are you positive the evidence can lead to his impeachment?"

entradas.text: "And I will support you not only with the vote but afterwards."
"I believe there are more people who needs to go."
entradas.menu: "I believe there are more people who needs to go."

entradas.text: "I can't promise that."
entradas.menu: "I can't promise that."

entradas.text: "Fine. It's a deal."
entradas.menu: "Fine. It's a deal."

entradas.text: "Looks like our meeting is over."
entradas.menu: "Looks like our meeting is over."

entradas.text: "How about another investment, Mr. Garaci? I'm sure we can find an amount you'd like."
entradas.menu: "How about another investment, Mr. Garaci? I'm sure we can find an amount you'd like."

entradas.text: "That's not in the terms."
"I make the terms here."
entradas.menu: "I make the terms here."

entradas.text: "I don't like your offer."
entradas.menu: "I don't like your offer."

entradas.text: "Fine. I like your offer. It's a deal."
entradas.menu: "Fine. I like your offer. It's a deal."

entradas.text: "Great to have come to an understanding."
"So, it's a deal?"
"No. I can't promise you such a thing."
entradas.menu: "No. I can't promise you such a thing."

entradas.text: "Yes. It's a deal."
entradas.menu: "Yes. It's a deal."

entradas.text: "How about a financial investment instead?"
entradas.menu: "How about a financial investment instead?"

entradas.text: "I'm listening."
"Here. I'll be generous. [-2 Personal Wealth]"
entradas.menu: "Here. I'll be generous. [-2 Personal Wealth]"

entradas.text: "I'm sure this would convince you. [-1 Personal Wealth]"
entradas.menu: "I'm sure this would convince you. [-1 Personal Wealth]"

entradas.text: "You'd better rethink your position, Mr. Garaci. I could have you dusted off."
entradas.menu: "You'd better rethink your position, Mr. Garaci. I could have you dusted off."

entradas.text: "You're threatening me?"
"You'd better rethink your position, Mr. Garaci. I could have you thrown in the can."
entradas.menu: "You'd better rethink your position, Mr. Garaci. I could have you thrown in the can."

entradas.text: "You're threatening me with that?"
"That was a clear death threat towards a Supreme Justice."
He put his hat back on.
He stood up.
"It's time I get going."
He laughed and put his hat back on.
"It looks like we don't share a collaborative spirit."
"Looks like it. Shame."
"It's time I get going then."
He put his hat back on and stood up.
"I guess this works."
He smiled.
"But I can now safely say that I will do my best to have your proposal pass the Court, Mr. President."
"Fine. I'll help you with the vote."
He put his hat back on.
"SIT DOWN."
entradas.menu: "SIT DOWN."

entradas.text: "You'll regret not supporting me."
entradas.menu: "You'll regret not supporting me."

entradas.text: "Farewell, Mr. Garaci."
entradas.menu: "Farewell, Mr. Garaci."

entradas.text: "It was nice to have you here, Mr. Garaci. I hope you'll reconsider your support."
entradas.menu: "It was nice to have you here, Mr. Garaci. I hope you'll reconsider your support."

entradas.text: "Thank you for inviting me here. It's a shame that we're leaving empty-handed, but it was a nice meeting."
"Goodbye, Mr. President. It was nice to talk to you."
"Goodbye, Mr. President."
"I am not your dog, Mr. Rayne."
"Don't forget your place."
He left me alone with my thoughts.
"Thank you for coming, Mr. Garaci. It was a fruitful meeting."
entradas.menu: "Thank you for coming, Mr. Garaci. It was a fruitful meeting."

entradas.text: "Looking forward to our cooperation."
entradas.menu: "Looking forward to our cooperation."

entradas.text: "I hope I can rely on you."
entradas.menu: "I hope I can rely on you."

entradas.text: We shook hands and he left me alone with my thoughts.
He straightened himself.
"I want to help you, Mr. President."
"I can organize the justices to vote for your proposal."
"Here. I'll be generous. [-2 Personal Wealth]"
entradas.menu: "Here. I'll be generous. [-2 Personal Wealth]"

entradas.text: "Fine. I'm sure this would convince you. [-1 Personal Wealth]"
entradas.menu: "Fine. I'm sure this would convince you. [-1 Personal Wealth]"

entradas.text: "If you can help me with some *investments,* I can be a valuable ally to have in the Supreme Court."
"And I will support you not only with the vote but afterwards."
"I'm sorry, Mr. Garaci. I don't have anything to spare."
entradas.menu: "I'm sorry, Mr. Garaci. I don't have anything to spare."

entradas.text: "I can't promise that."
entradas.menu: "I can't promise that."

entradas.text: "I thought you were the one who asked for my help, Mr. President."
"I gave you my offer. If you don't like it, there will be no support from my end. Easy as that."
"Can we figure something else out?"
entradas.menu: "Can we figure something else out?"

entradas.text: "No."
"I already have a reasonable support behind me."
"With the evidence I can provide, you can make a case to the Assembly to start his impeachment process."
"In such a circumstance, I'm pretty sure the members of the assembly would proceed with it. Mr. Hawker is not enjoying his old popularity anymore. We all know that."
"Well, yes. The new changes will allow the Grand National Assembly to impeach the justices. I thought your intention was to use that for your own interest."
"I see. That makes sense."
entradas.menu: "I see. That makes sense."
